title: Zac Taylor: Duke Tobin is "really apologetic" after backing out of trade with Eagles

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zac Taylor: Duke Tobin is "really apologetic" after backing out of trade with Eagles
sources.description: On Tuesday, the Bengals backed out of a trade for edge rusher Arnold Ebiketie after it was revealed that the deal might cost Cincinnati with a future compensatory draft pick.
